name: @linked-science/cleanroom-node-repl
description: Consumer-owned clean-room JavaScript runtime and mediated Linked Science transport

scripts.check: node --check src/cleanroom-mcp.mjs && node --check src/repl-kernel-child.mjs && node --check src/peek-runtime.mjs && node --check src/linked-science-broker.mjs && node -e "Promise.all([import('./src/cleanroom-mcp.mjs'), import('./src/peek-runtime.mjs'), import('./src/linked-science-broker.mjs')]).then(([mcp, peek, linkedScience]) => { if (typeof mcp.createRequestHandler !== 'function' || typeof peek.PeekRegistry !== 'function' || typeof linkedScience.LinkedScienceNetworkBroker !== 'function') process.exit(1) })"
